title: polyphlebium hymenophylloides
intro: Polyphlebium hymenophylloides, commonly known as the Hymenophyllaceae family fern, is a type of non-vascular, epiphytic fern native to tropical and subtropical regions. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds, respiratory issues, and gastrointestinal problems. The therapeutic actions of Polyphlebium hymenophylloides include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
